$comment: Measured budgets from docs/workspace/specs/47-performance-budgets.md. A miss blocks release. Update with measurements, never with estimates.
$frameworkFloorNote: react-dom 67,510 + vinext runtime 44,283 + vinext browser entry 31,418. This is the fixed cost of React 19 + vinext; it changes only with a deliberate framework upgrade. Re-measure with `node scripts/check-budget.mjs` when it does.

/workspace.$comment: The 150 KB (153,600 B) target is superseded, not missed: the framework floor is 143 KB, so even zero app code and zero icons would land near 159 KB. See the decision in spec 47.

assets.$comment: The agent runtime is fetched lazily on the first turn and is never precached, so it is budgeted separately from the initial route payload.

/agent-runtime/edapex_agent_wasm_bg.wasm.reason: crates/agent-wasm core; replaces a 9.9 MB xcodex payload

/sqlite/sqlite3.wasm.reason: SQLite engine for the browser store; lazy, never precached

pwa.$comment: Spec 47 §76: the WASM runtime does not count toward this shell budget.

measured.note: Measured on a vinext build with Node 26.13.1. The Pages rollback baseline in spec 47 (106 KB) is a different build and is not comparable. The lazy document editor (188 KB) is not in this figure because it loads only when the artifact panel opens. The SQLite engine (773 KB gzip, approved ceiling 1.2 MB) is lazy: it loads only when the store is opened.
